svg.aria-label: Per-thread busy time — contiguous blocks — View 1
svg.text: Per-thread busy time — contiguous blocks — View 1
Each bar is the time one thread spends computing its row band.
Wall time is bounded below by the tallest bar; shorter bars are idle capacity. Fastest of 5 runs per process, best of 3 processes.
Source: results/step3 — fastest of 5 runs per process, best of 3 processes.
